whenToUse: A desktop-app style File, Edit, View bar for editors and back-office tools.
Menus with submenus, checkbox and radio items and keyboard shortcuts.
avoidWhen: A single overflow menu on a button — use dropdown-menu.
Website navigation with links — use navigation-menu.
a11y: One tab stop with arrow keys between menus; give the bar an aria-label naming what it controls.
